title: Wedding Reception Run Sheet — Ashgrove Barn
notes: Program start is the moment the ceremony breaks. Two manual gates: the planner calls the room (seat-guests) and the MC cues the speeches. The canape window is the only variable duration before dinner and carries the photography slack. Clearing is anchored to when a course went out, not to when serving finished, so both clear steps use afterStepWithBuffer with event 'start'. Dancing is indefinite: the run sheet ends it on the band's last set, not on a clock.
